hook.line: Illegal Claude tips you shouldn't know, part 37 - all 60 hidden commands.
hook.visual: Creator holding a lav mic in a dim room, glancing off-camera; a persistent top banner with the orange Claude logo and 'Illegal Claude Tips Part 37'

beats.what: Series banner and 'illegal tips' line, creator looks off then into camera
Cut to a printed cheat sheet: keyboard shortcuts page; 'take a screenshot'
Camera pans across the slash-commands column
Workflow tips section of the sheet
Laptop screen with the two-page sheet, hand holds up two fingers
Back to face: comment the word to get the free cheat sheet

why_it_works: Comment-a-keyword for a free cheat sheet turns the payoff into an engagement trigger (23,100 comments in the meta)
The cheat sheet is shown too fast to read, so viewers screenshot, save or comment to get it
'Part 37' plus a fixed branded banner signals a long-running series and builds return viewing
'Illegal' framing creates a forbidden-knowledge gap in under 2 s
weaknesses: No motion graphics at all (0 events measured); the middle is just a camera drifting over paper
The value is withheld behind the comment gate, so the video itself teaches nothing concrete
Small dense sheet text is unreadable on a phone; the transcription even misspells Claude
for_robert: Use a keyword-comment CTA tied to a concrete freebie, and keep a fixed series banner; Fred could hold up the cheat sheet page by page instead of a camera pan.
